condition.label: Favourable
condition.action: Normal long exposure is permitted, subject to setup quality and your usual risk limits.

methodology.daily: Stocks moving at least 4% on the day, with at least 100,000 shares and volume above the prior session.
methodology.liquidity: Latest price at least $3 and 20-session average dollar volume at least $250,000.
methodology.primary: Stocks 25% above their 65-session low versus stocks 25% below their 65-session high.
methodology.fast: Stocks 13% above their 34-session low versus stocks 13% below their 34-session high.
methodology.ratio: Ten-session total of 4% up moves divided by 4% down moves.
methodology.high_momentum: Stocks up more than 45% over the previous 10 sessions; chart shows the 10-session moving average of the daily count.
methodology.condition: Four equal signals: primary breadth, fast breadth, 10-day breadth dominance and ONEQ 10/20-day trend.
